name: Remote MCP Server on Cloudflare
description: A template for deploying MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers with OAuth authentication. Enables remote access to MCP tools through SSE transport, allowing Claude Desktop and other clients to connect via HTTP instead of local stdio.
